question: What received optical power is considered healthy at the ONT?

expected_chunks.section: FTTP ONT Installation and Fault Guide > Fault code LOS (loss of signal)

reference: Healthy received optical power at the ONT is between -8 dBm and -27 dBm.

question: What does a solid red LOS light on the ONT mean?

expected_chunks.section: FTTP ONT Installation and Fault Guide > ONT status lights

reference: A solid red LOS light means loss of signal: no light is reaching the ONT.

question: What is the minimum bend radius for the internal fibre drop cable?

expected_chunks.section: FTTP ONT Installation and Fault Guide > Mounting the ONT

reference: The minimum bend radius for the internal fibre drop cable is 30 mm.

question: How long should I wait if the PON light keeps flashing before escalating?

expected_chunks.section: FTTP ONT Installation and Fault Guide > Registration fault PON flashing for more than 5 minutes

reference: Escalate if the PON light flashes for more than 5 minutes.

question: What is the minimum acceptable insulation resistance on a copper line?

expected_chunks.section: Copper Line Fault Diagnosis (DSL) > Insulation resistance
Copper Access Network Manual > Insulation resistance limits

reference: Insulation resistance should be at least 1 megohm.

question: Loop resistance is above 1300 ohms, what does that indicate?

expected_chunks.section: Copper Line Fault Diagnosis (DSL) > Loop resistance
Copper Access Network Manual > Loop resistance limits

reference: Loop resistance above 1300 ohms points to a high-resistance joint.

question: How many DSL sync drops in 24 hours should trigger a noise check?

expected_chunks.section: Copper Line Fault Diagnosis (DSL) > Noise and DSL sync problems
Copper Access Network Manual > DSL sync and noise

reference: More than 3 sync drops in 24 hours should trigger a noise check.

question: What voltage triggers the cabinet BATTERY LOW alarm?

expected_chunks.section: Street Cabinet Power Alarm Runbook > Battery alarm

reference: A BATTERY LOW alarm means the batteries are below 46 volts.

question: How often should street cabinet batteries be replaced?

expected_chunks.section: Street Cabinet Power Alarm Runbook > Battery alarm

reference: Batteries should be replaced every 4 years even if they test good.

question: At what temperature is the cabinet HIGH TEMP alarm raised?

expected_chunks.section: Street Cabinet Power Alarm Runbook > High temperature alarm

reference: The HIGH TEMP alarm is raised at 55 degrees Celsius.

question: How many people are required to work inside a powered street cabinet?

expected_chunks.section: Street Cabinet Power Alarm Runbook > Before opening the cabinet
Field Safety and Equipment Manual > Street cabinet electrical safety

reference: Two people are required when working inside a powered street cabinet.

question: Which fault code do I raise if the drop cable tests good?

expected_chunks.section: FTTP ONT Installation and Fault Guide > Fault code LOS (loss of signal)

reference: Raise LOS-NET when the drop cable tests good but power is still low.

question: What does a MAINS FAIL alarm mean?

expected_chunks.section: Street Cabinet Power Alarm Runbook > Mains failure alarm

reference: A MAINS FAIL alarm means the cabinet is running on battery.

question: What is the end-to-end loss budget for a standard GPON circuit?
reference: The end-to-end loss budget is 28 dB from the OLT port to the ONT.

question: How much loss does a 1:32 splitter add?
reference: A 1:32 splitter adds 17.1 dB.

question: What should I fit if received power at the ONT is above -8 dBm?
reference: Fit a 5 dB inline attenuator when received power is above -8 dBm.

question: Below what transmit power must an ONT be replaced?
reference: An ONT transmitting below 0.5 dBm has a failing laser and must be replaced.

question: What is the difference between a flashing red LOS and a solid red LOS?
reference: Flashing red means signal present but below threshold; solid red means the path is broken.

question: Which fibre fault code is routed to the local civils team?
reference: LOS-DROP is routed to the local civils team.

question: When should I raise fault code ONT-HW?
reference: Raise ONT-HW for a solid amber alarm, transmit power below 0.5 dBm, or a unit that will not boot.

question: What OTDR pulse width should I use for a drop cable fault under 500 metres?
reference: Use a 10 ns pulse width for drop cable faults under 500 m.

question: How long must the OTDR launch fibre be?
reference: The launch fibre must be at least 150 m.

question: What reflectance limit applies to an APC connector?
reference: Reflectance on an APC connector should be below -60 dB.

question: What pressure should a joint closure be tested to before burying it?
reference: Pressure test the closure to 0.5 bar for 5 minutes.

question: What must be recorded on an acceptance test for a new fibre installation?
reference: Record received power, transmit power, splitter node and leg, ONT serial number, date and engineer.

question: What loop resistance per kilometre is expected for 0.63 mm conductor?

expected_chunks.section: Copper Access Network Manual > Loop resistance limits

reference: Expect roughly 36 ohms per kilometre for 0.63 mm conductor.

question: What is the line capacitance per kilometre on copper?

expected_chunks.section: Copper Access Network Manual > Capacitance and line length

reference: Line capacitance is about 50 nanofarads per kilometre.

question: What voltage on an idle pair counts as a battery contact fault?

expected_chunks.section: Copper Access Network Manual > Battery contact faults

reference: Any reading above 5 volts DC on an idle pair is a battery contact fault.

question: What is a healthy downstream signal to noise margin?

expected_chunks.section: Copper Access Network Manual > Signal to noise margin

reference: A healthy downstream signal to noise margin is 6 dB or more.

question: Above what attenuation should a customer be offered fibre rather than a copper repair?

expected_chunks.section: Copper Access Network Manual > Attenuation guidance

reference: Above 50 dB the line is at its practical limit and fibre should be offered.

question: Why does a cleaned joint in aluminium cable fail again?

expected_chunks.section: Copper Access Network Manual > High resistance joints

reference: A cleaned joint in aluminium cable re-oxidises within weeks; re-make it instead.

question: What type of connector must be used on aluminium conductor?

expected_chunks.section: Copper Access Network Manual > Aluminium cable handling

reference: Use only aluminium-rated connectors on aluminium conductor.

question: What causes a copper line to degrade gradually as neighbours take up service?

expected_chunks.section: Copper Access Network Manual > Crosstalk

reference: Crosstalk rises with the number of active DSL services in the same binder group.

question: Why must the customer router be unplugged before a copper line test?

expected_chunks.section: Copper Access Network Manual > Line test procedure

reference: A test with the router connected shows a false low insulation resistance.

question: What colour is pair 6 in the standard 25-pair code?

expected_chunks.section: Copper Access Network Manual > Standard pair colours

reference: Pair 6 is red-blue.

question: At what angle should a ladder be set?

expected_chunks.section: Field Safety and Equipment Manual > Ladder work

reference: Set a ladder at 75 degrees, one unit out for every four units up.

question: How far must a ladder extend above the stepping off point?

expected_chunks.section: Field Safety and Equipment Manual > Ladder work

reference: The ladder must extend at least 1 metre above the stepping off point.

question: What depth makes a footway chamber a confined space?

expected_chunks.section: Field Safety and Equipment Manual > Confined space entry

reference: A footway chamber deeper than 1.5 metres is a confined space.

question: What oxygen readings mean do not enter a chamber?

expected_chunks.section: Field Safety and Equipment Manual > Confined space entry

reference: Oxygen below 19.5 per cent or above 23.5 per cent means do not enter.

question: How often are insulated gloves withdrawn from service?

expected_chunks.section: Field Safety and Equipment Manual > Personal protective equipment

reference: Insulated gloves are withdrawn after 6 months regardless of condition.

question: What is the cone taper length on a 40 mile per hour road?

expected_chunks.section: Field Safety and Equipment Manual > Traffic management

reference: The taper length is 30 metres on a 40 mile per hour road.

question: What is the minimum clearance from an overhead power line?

expected_chunks.section: Field Safety and Equipment Manual > Working near overhead power

reference: Maintain a minimum clearance of 3 metres from any overhead power line.

question: How long does a permit from the power network operator take?

expected_chunks.section: Field Safety and Equipment Manual > Working near overhead power

reference: A permit takes 10 working days.

question: Above what weight are two people required for a lift?

expected_chunks.section: Field Safety and Equipment Manual > Manual handling

reference: Two people are required for any load above 25 kilograms.

question: How often is a gas detector calibrated?

expected_chunks.section: Field Safety and Equipment Manual > Test equipment calibration

reference: Gas detectors are fully calibrated every 6 months.

question: How long after a missed book off is a welfare check triggered?

expected_chunks.section: Field Safety and Equipment Manual > Lone working

reference: A missed book off triggers a welfare check after 60 minutes.

question: How often must a pole be formally inspected?

expected_chunks.section: Field Safety and Equipment Manual > Pole testing

reference: Poles are formally inspected every 10 years.

question: I measured -29 dBm at the ONT and the drop cable tests good. Which fault code do I raise and what must I include in the note?
reference: Below -27 dBm with a good drop cable is LOS-NET; include the meter reading and the splitter node identifier.

question: A cabinet battery reads 11.2 volts after a full charge. What do I do, and what protection do I need to handle it?

expected_chunks.section: Street Cabinet Power Alarm Runbook > Battery alarm
Field Safety and Equipment Manual > Street cabinet battery backup

reference: Replace the string below 11.5 volts; wear safety glasses and acid resistant gloves and never lift a battery alone.

question: A copper line fails insulation resistance and the distribution point is overhead. What must I do before climbing?

expected_chunks.section: Copper Access Network Manual > Distribution point access
Field Safety and Equipment Manual > Pole testing

reference: Access overhead distribution points from a ladder only after the pole test has passed.

question: My optical power meter is 40 days past its calibration date. Can I use it for an acceptance test?

expected_chunks.section: Field Safety and Equipment Manual > Test equipment calibration

reference: Equipment more than 30 days past calibration must not be used for acceptance testing.
